The 3-qubit GHZ circuit ran on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. The final job is 01a15f4d-9e80-739c-a53e-3e5d134fbb54 and it completed. Counts: 000=49, 111=41, 110=5, 100=2, 101=2, 001=1. 90 of 100 shots were 000 or 111, so the fraction is 0.90.

Before the real run, I tested the same circuit on the free sirius:mock alias as job 01a15f4d-7299-7116-a594-ef3034478371. That mock job returned 000=100 and cost no credits. The transpiled circuit used 5 r gates, 4 move gates, 2 cz gates and 3 measurements.

Credits: the API does not report a credit amount. GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} for the real job returns metrics.billed_seconds = 1.0, execution_seconds = 0.219 and runtime_seconds = 0.288. It has no credits or cost field. I set credits_reported to 0 because the API gave no credit figure. If you apply the IQM Academy rate for Sirius (0.3 credits per second, not confirmed for this account) to 1.0 billed second, you get about 0.3 credits. That is my estimate, not an API value. The dashboard at https://resonance.iqm.tech/jobs/01a15f4d-9e80-739c-a53e-3e5d134fbb54 shows the actual cost.
